name: Year Picker
description: A popover grid of years with decade paging for fast year-only selection.

anatomy.description: A read-only field showing the selected year, with a calendar affordance.
Stepper buttons that page the grid by decade; the visible range is announced through an aria-live region.
Twelve year buttons per page; the selected year is aria-pressed and the current year aria-current.
Years outside minDate and maxDate stay visible but cannot be chosen.

dos: Use it when only the year matters, like graduation, fiscal, or model years.
Bound the range with minDate and maxDate for windows like recent fiscal years.
Format the emitted January 1 Date down to the year for display.
donts: Don't use it when the month or day is also needed; use MonthPicker or DatePicker.
Don't use it for free numeric year entry at scale; a NumberInput types faster.

examples.title: Year grid with decade paging
examples.description: Twelve years render per page while the header steps by decade, emitting January 1 of the chosen year.

examples.title: Bounded year range
examples.description: minDate and maxDate disable years outside the range, such as recent fiscal years only.

guidance.useWhen: Only the year matters, such as graduation, fiscal, or model years, and scrolling a full calendar would be noise.
guidance.avoidWhen: The month or day is also needed; use MonthPicker or DatePicker instead.
guidance.behavior: Clicking or pressing Enter on a year commits January 1 and closes the popover; arrow keys move focus and page the grid automatically at the edges.
guidance.responsive: The input fills its container; the three-column year grid keeps a fixed compact width.

keyboard.action: Opens the popover from the input.
Moves the focused year by one, paging at the edges.
Moves the focused year by three.
Jumps to the first or last year of the page.

notes: The selected year is exposed with aria-pressed and the current year with aria-current.
The visible year range is announced through an aria-live region as pages change.
